subject: 4PH1
skill: Solve a one-dimensional force balance with signed directions; direct resultant and separately proposed inverse-force adaptations.

customQuiz.rationale: The original uses separate magnitude and direction credit. Three-force and inverse tasks broaden the original demand and still require marking calibration before acceptance.

requirements: An original one-axis scenario with two or three labelled forces and all required magnitudes/directions.
Either all forces are supplied and resultant requested, or force A is omitted and resultant plus all other forces supplied.
Force values expressed to one decimal place in N. Other-axis forces explicitly balance.
evidenceContract: Store the signed integer-tenths parameter vector privately.
Validate the actual displayed force readings against the signed physical model.
Keep magnitude, direction, working and rubric outside the public question projection.

constraints: Applies independently to each force magnitude; multiply by a sampled sign.
At least one force each way; resultant must not be zero.
For missing-force, omit exactly A and supply resultant.
The same complete physical data is available in either form.
Select from three axis-appropriate apparatus contexts.
No zero-resultant case: it needs a separate direction rubric.
No forces outside 0.5–25.0 N individually, including after sign inversion.
Missing-force and three-force variants remain provisional despite successful algebra tests.
relationships: magnitude = absolute(signed_target); sign determines the axis direction
difficultyControls: Change direct to inverse demand, representation and number of contributors.
Do not equate a two-mark maximum with difficulty.

transformations.conditions: Use one of three coherent scenarios per axis.
All three contributions explicitly provided or included in the inverse equation.
A single unknown and a complete net force are supplied.
Direction credit requires a different question and scheme.

solutionProcedure: Convert each force to a signed contribution.
Sum contributions or rearrange the balance for the omitted force.
Return the absolute magnitude in N with its sign-derived direction.

criteria.rule: Correct non-negative magnitude of the requested target, in the requested N unit.
Correct unambiguous direction along the stated axis.

acceptableAlternatives: Equivalent decimal values and equivalent directional wording.
A signed value is acceptable only when its sign convention is unambiguous.
dependencies: Magnitude and direction are separate credit points.
Inverse-task responses must identify force A, not merely repeat the supplied resultant.
contradictionRules: Contradictory direction claims cannot receive direction credit without resolution; calibration pending.
Do not double-credit multiple descriptions of the same magnitude or direction.

tolerance.roundingRule: Exact tenths generated; equivalent decimal representations accepted. No rounding required.

commonErrors.description: Adding opposed forces instead of signed contributions.
Omitting a physical direction or using an unqualified compass term for a vertical diagram.

testPlan: 200 deterministic seeds, all 16 structural combinations and 96 explicit boundary/context cases.
Reject out-of-range, zero-resultant and same-direction-only input.
Detect altered private solutions or public readings.
Before promotion, calibrate free-text marking, alternatives, contradictions and inverse/three-force demands against reviewed exemplars.
36 hand-authored final-answer cases: exact/equivalent units, separate marks, arrows, wrong direction, unqualified compass direction, exact decimal preservation and unsupported-direction deferral.

16 independently answered structural fixtures with 96 synthetic marking outcomes cover both tasks, axes, force counts and representations; assessment difficulty and real-student calibration remain open.

runtime.seedPolicy: Unsigned 32-bit seed, deterministic integer-tenths sampling; persist the complete validated package before any future serving. Current output is experimental and cannot start a quiz. Parameter sampling is bounded to 20 attempts; maxRetries refers to external generation retries, currently none.

blockers: Mathematical/representation and bounded final-answer calibration checks pass; full pedagogical validation is still partial.
General free-text marking, signed-convention and contradiction interpretation remain deferred; the offline final-answer marker is not live.
Inverse and three-force adaptations need assessment-demand review.
Per-task assessment objective allocation remains unassigned.
Not registered for live sessions; zero active templates.
